frase_inicial: Michael: the January home and your retirement both need the same dollars

tarjetas.frente: Cash is thin before the house
tarjetas.reverso: If you set aside the down payment and the vacation, your available cash would be gone and everyday bills would rely on cards or selling investments.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash today $30,000; near-term cash needs Jan 2027 $116,800 (home + vacation).

tarjetas.frente: Retirement is short of the plan
tarjetas.reverso: At your target retirement age, savings alone are projected to run short years before your plan ends, so future spending could be reduced unless you change course now.
tarjetas.detalle: Retirement gap today ~ $1,177,586; savings run out at age 85 leaving planned unpaid spending $32,439.

tarjetas.frente: Life and liability cover is low
tarjetas.reverso: If something happened, your single income and current policies leave big needs uncovered; this is about protecting what your paychecks support.
tarjetas.detalle: Life cover $180,000 vs recommended $900k–$1.8M; no umbrella policy recorded.

tarjetas.reverso: That credit card is your most expensive debt; keeping its current payment schedule means it closes in the next year or two, but it still eats budget while you build cash.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $3,500 at 20% APR, $200 monthly payment projected payoff July 2028.

tarjetas.reverso: Good news: you get the full employer match, so your long-term saving habit is working; choices now are about where to shift money without stopping that habit.
tarjetas.detalle: 401(k) contributions include full $7,000 employer match; current 401(k) contribution $17,000.

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: The plan flags no umbrella protection; adding it raises your liability shield and addresses a clear gap without touching retirement savings or the home cash right away.
